name: Patrón de Respiración
mechanism:
This method detects deepfakes by analyzing breathing patterns as biological signals following Ciftci et al. (2020):

1. **Chest/Shoulder Movimiento Extracción**: Periodic chest expansion and shoulder elevation associated with respiration are tracked via body landmark detection. The respiratory motion signal is extracted by measuring vertical displacement of shoulder landmarks and chest region optical flow, compensating for other body movements.

2. **Respiratory Rate Estimación**: The respiratory signal's power spectrum is analyzed to extract breathing frequency. Normal resting respiratory rate is 12-20 breaths/minute (0.2-0.33 Hz). The method checks: (a) presence of a clear respiratory spectral peak, (b) rate within physiological range, (c) consistency across the recording.

3. **Breathing Regularity Análisis**: Natural breathing exhibits characteristic variability — respiratory rate varies with cognitive load, speech, and autonomic regulation. The coefficient of variation of inter-breath intervals follows expected distributions. AI-generated video may show either absent breathing motion or artificially regular breathing without natural variability.

4. **Cardio - Respiratory Coupling**: In authentic subjects, breathing and heart rate show physiological coupling (respiratory sinus arrhythmia — heart rate increases during inspiration). The method checks cross-correlation between extracted respiratory and cardiac (rPPG) signals. Deepfakes lack this physiological coupling, as neither signal is generated from real biological processes.

5. **Habla - Breathing Coordination**: During speech in video, breathing patterns synchronize with linguistic phrasing — speakers inhale at phrase boundaries. The method verifies that detected inspiration events align with speech pause patterns. AI-generated videos typically fail to produce coordinated speech-breathing dynamics, serving as a forensic indicator.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante breathing pattern analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Ciftci, U.A. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
Qi, H. et al. (2020). DeepRhythm: Exposing DeepFakes with Attentional Visual Heartbeat Rhythms. ACM MM.
